why: The archive contains a symlink pointing outside the root (or a symlink then a write through it). Symlinks are rejected outright by the archive policy (ARCHIVE_UNSAFE).
notes: Hostile payload is the ARCHIVE ENCODING, not a directory. The e2e driver runs make-archive.sh to produce the malicious tar and uploads THOSE bytes. The directory package here is a well-formed placeholder for documentation and the local loader.
